Team —

I attached the audit (close_window_audit_q2.xlsx) and a SFDC export for the accounts I could pull.

Action items (can we please complete within 48 hours):

- If you change the Close Date beyond the quarter boundary, add a short justification in the "Close Change Reason" field (examples: awaiting PO, legal redline, technical POC delay).
- If an opportunity is stale, archive it or mark as "Needs Re-qualification" so finance can exclude from commit.

Related: I need a one-line confirmation for each deal in the attached sheet (column: "RA Action") listing either: "Confirm (on-track, new close date MM/DD)" or "Archive/Uncommit - reason".

Marissa — can you coordinate the SFDC bulk updates with Ben if you need help? Lauren — ping me if you think any deals deserve an exception and include the specific reasons; we can adjudicate exceptions on Monday morning.

Thanks,
